SUBSCRIBE_ASSET_ERROR: An error occurred while trying to subscribe to the asset

INVALID_ARRAY_TYPE: The field must be an array
FIELD_SHOULD_NOT_BE_EMPTY: The field should not be empty
INVALID_OBJECT_TYPE: The field must be an object
PROPERTY_SHOULD_NOT_EXIST: The field property should not exist
INVALID_STRING_TYPE: The field must be a string
FIELD_EXCEEDS_MAXIMUM: The field must not be greater than the maximum allowed value
INVALID_POSITIVE_NUMBER: The field must be a positive number
INVALID_NUMBER_CONSTRAINTS: The field must be a number conforming to the specified constraints
INVALID_INTEGER_TYPE: The field must be an integer number
DUPLICATE_VALUES_NOT_ALLOWED: All elements in the field must be unique
